dataset.label_origin: Explicit synthetic fixtures with manually specified labels and rationales; no external LLM labels or industrial validation.

limitations: Small, curated synthetic development set, not a held-out industrial benchmark.
Instruction mappings and transcript completeness are supplied review metadata.
No audio transcription, industrial safety approval, latency benchmark, or AMD-backed inference has been demonstrated.

metric_definitions.acceptable_escalation_rate: acceptable predicted critical or review / all acceptable
metric_definitions.critical_deviation_precision: critical predicted critical / all predicted critical; unresolved labels predicted critical count as false positives
metric_definitions.critical_deviation_recall: critical predicted critical / all critical; critical sent to review counts as a miss
metric_definitions.decision_errors: decision differs from label mapping ACCEPTABLE->PASS_CANDIDATE, CRITICAL->CRITICAL_DEVIATION, UNRESOLVED->REVIEW_REQUIRED
metric_definitions.unresolved_rate: REVIEW_REQUIRED decisions / all cases; critical results may also contain unresolved findings
